title: Dunhuang Daxiefei Decoction ameliorates acute lung injury via the HIF-1alpha/glycolysis/H3K18la axis.
authors: Wang, Jiayun; Jiao, Liangbo; Yan, Zhiqiang; Wang, Shun; Wu, Suwan; Guo, Tao; Yang, Yuetong; Su, Xiaoyingzi; Tan, Bo; Yang, Aidong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过HIF-1α/糖酵解/H3K18乳酰化轴缓解急性肺损伤，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心为炎症代谢机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Acute lung injury (ALI) lacks effective therapies. HIF-1alpha-driven glycolysis can promote histone lactylation and sustain pro-inflammatory (M1) macrophage responses. Daxiefei Decoction (DXFD), a classic traditional Chinese medicine formula, is used for pulmonary inflammatory diseases, but its immunometabolic mechanism remains unclear. AIM OF THE STUDY: To evaluate the protective efficacy of DXFD against lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced ALI and to determine whether it acts through the HIF-1alpha/glycolysis/histone H3K18 lactylation (H3K18la) axis to regulate macrophage polarization. MATERIALS & METHODS: DXFD constituents were characterized by UPLC-LTQ-Orbitrap-MS/MS, followed by network pharmacology, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. Lung transcriptomics and metabolomics were performed in ALI mice. Efficacy and mechanisms were assessed in LPS-challenged mice and RAW264.7 macrophages using histopathology, ELISA, qRT-PCR, Western blotting, and immunofluorescence. HIF-1alpha overexpression was used for validation. RESULTS: DXFD dose-dependently alleviated lung injury and reduced pro-inflammatory cytokines in vivo, and suppressed M1 polarization in vivo and in LPS-stimulated macrophages. Multi-omics indicated activation of HIF-1alpha-associated inflammatory and glycolytic programs in ALI, which were normalized by DXFD. DXFD decreased glycolytic enzyme expression and reduced histone H3K18 lactylation (H3K18la); these effects were partially reversed by HIF-1alpha overexpression. Molecular docking and dynamics suggested stable binding of baicalin to HIF-1alpha. CONCLUSIONS: DXFD mitigates ALI by dampening HIF-1alpha-dependent glycolysis and H3K18la, thereby restraining M1-driven inflammatory amplification.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：急性肺损伤（ALI）缺乏有效疗法。HIF-1α驱动的糖酵解可促进组蛋白乳酸化并维持促炎性（M1）巨噬细胞反应。大蝎肺汤（DXFD）是一种经典中药方剂，用于肺部炎症性疾病，但其免疫代谢机制尚不清楚。研究目的：评估DXFD对脂多糖（LPS）诱导的ALI的保护效果，并确定其是否通过HIF-1α/糖酵解/组蛋白H3K18乳酸化（H3K18la）轴调节巨噬细胞极化。材料与方法：通过UPLC-LTQ-Orbitrap-MS/MS表征DXFD成分，随后进行网络药理学、分子对接和分子动力学（MD）模拟。在ALI小鼠中进行肺转录组学和代谢组学分析。在LPS攻击的小鼠和RAW264.7巨噬细胞中，通过组织病理学、ELISA、qRT-PCR、Western blotting和免疫荧光评估疗效和机制。使用HIF-1α过表达进行验证。结果：DXFD剂量依赖性地减轻了体内肺损伤并降低了促炎细胞因子，且在体内和LPS刺激的巨噬细胞中抑制了M1极化。多组学分析表明，ALI中HIF-1α相关炎症和糖酵解程序被激活，而DXFD使其正常化。DXFD降低了糖酵解酶表达并减少了组蛋白H3K18乳酸化（H3K18la）；这些效应部分被HIF-1α过表达逆转。分子对接和动力学表明黄芩苷与HIF-1α稳定结合。结论：DXFD通过抑制HIF-1α依赖性糖酵解和H3K18la减轻ALI，从而限制M1驱动的炎症放大。
